data.derivation_status: R9 = ℏ_q^6 × q / 5 is empirically suggestive but NOT structurally derived. The 'q' multiplier (anti-bar-invariant) and '5' divisor (matching T(2,5) muon knot crossings) hint at categorical content but have no Lean theorem yet. Promotion from 'near-match' to 'derived' requires: (1) Lean ℏ_q^6 categorical origin, (2) Lean q × (1/5) T(2,5)-factor derivation, (3) cross-anchor electron/tau consistency check.
